summary: Frontend-only verification completed for landing-to-portfolio flow, Work carousel behavior, responsive layouts, accessibility basics, and production build. Core requested behaviors passed; one touch/pointer robustness concern needs manual confirmation on physical mobile devices.

ui_bugs.issue: Pointer-capture runtime error can be triggered in touch-pointer edge simulation: 'Failed to execute setPointerCapture on Element: No active pointer with the given id is found.'

integration_issues.flow: Mobile touch swipe on Work carousel
integration_issues.issue: Automated synthetic touch-pointer path triggered runtime overlay once; real user touch behavior should be manually revalidated on device/browser matrix.

action_items: Manually retest carousel swipe on real mobile hardware (iOS Safari + Android Chrome) to confirm one-tile-per-swipe without pointer-capture errors.
Harden pointer capture in carousel handler defensively (guard/try-catch) to avoid runtime breakage on unexpected pointer event sequences.
critical_code_review_comments: Work carousel wheel logic, guard windows (landing 450ms, portfolio 700ms), keyboard support, disabled-tab behavior, and reset-to-first-slide behavior are implemented correctly.
Deferred tabs (Writing/Patent/Profile/Contact) are correctly rendered as aria-disabled and non-navigating per scope.
No hardcoded internal localhost URL usage observed; frontend uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from env.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated: Portfolio CTA, bottom portfolio link, landing wheel/touch entry, Home/logo return, re-entry reset to first tile, direct /portfolio load, six nav items, disabled tabs, indicator clicks, keyboard controls, boundaries, large delta + inertial wheel one-step behavior, wide card visibility, unknown-route home return, reduced motion smoke, and yarn build success. Mobile clean screenshot captured after load with controls visible. Treat deferred tabs/content as intentional, not defects.
rca of the issue: RCA: Carousel onPointerDown always calls setPointerCapture(pointerId). In synthetic/edge pointer sequences where pointer is not active for the element, this throws and can surface runtime overlay. Reproduction (automation): dispatch touch-style pointerdown/up on project viewport without a true active pointer stream. Mitigation: guard with try/catch or conditionally call setPointerCapture only when safe; keep onPointerCancel cleanup.
